translation_es_ar: ¡Gracias de nuevo por participar en este proyecto de investigación! Estimamos que diligenciar la siguiente parte de la encuesta le tomará aproximadamente 20-30 minutos. En esta encuesta se le harán preguntas sobre su hogar y sobre usted mismo(a).Le agradecemos que responda la encuesta de la forma más precisa posible con la información que tiene disponible. Si tiene alguna duda, comuníquesela a quien coordina esta aplicación. Cuando esté listo(a) para empezar, seleccione el botón "Comenzar Encuesta".¡Muchas gracias!
back_translation: Thank you again for participating in this research project! We estimate that completing the next part of the survey will take you approximately 20-30 minutes. This survey will ask you questions about your household and about yourself. We appreciate you answering the survey as accurately as possible with the information you have available. If you have any questions, please contact the person coordinating this survey. When you are ready to begin, select the "Start Survey" button. Thank you very much!

source_en: Sophie can't find her shoe because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.
translation_es_ar: Sofía no encuentra su zapato porque Jaime, por hacerle una broma, se lo escondió en la caja de juguetes hace un rato cuando nadie estaba mirando.
back_translation: Sofia can't find her shoe because Jaime, as a joke, hid it in the toy box a while ago when no one was looking.

source_en: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
back_translation: Is Mom angry with Johan now?

source_en: Is Allie being mean and naughty for taking Mike’s pencil?
translation_es_ar: ¿Alejandra está siendo mala y traviesa por agarrar el lápiz de Miguel?
back_translation: Is Alejandra being naughty and mischievous by grabbing Miguel's pencil?

source_en: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
translation_es_ar: Isabel le pide disculpas a Johan y le da un fuerte abrazo. Johan le devuelve el abrazo, y Mamá se une a ellos.
back_translation: Isabel apologizes to Johan and gives him a big hug. Johan hugs her back, and Mom joins them.

source_en: James tells Sophie that he’s very sorry, and Sophie and Dad forgive James. They all hug.
translation_es_ar: Jaime le pide perdón a Sofía, y Sofía y el papá perdonan a Jaime. Todos se abrazan.
back_translation: Jaime apologizes to Sofia, and Sofia and her father forgive Jaime. They all hug.

source_en: Is Sophie mad at James now?
back_translation: Is Sofia angry with Jaime now?

source_en: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
translation_es_ar: ¿Elián está siendo malo y travieso al agarrar el libro de Ana?
back_translation: Is Elián being naughty and mischievous by grabbing Ana's book?

source_en: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
translation_es_ar: María llega a la tienda y dice "me gustaría comprar camisas." La vendedora responde "Sólo nos quedan medias." Como María también necesita medias, decide comprar algunos pares.
back_translation: Maria arrives at the store and says, "I'd like to buy some shirts." The saleswoman replies, "We only have socks left." Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to buy a few pairs.

source_en: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
back_translation: Is Mom angry with Isabel now?

source_en: Is Bobby being mean and naughty for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
translation_es_ar: ¿Roberto está siendo malo y travieso por agarrar la pelota de fútbol de Anna?
back_translation: Is Roberto being naughty and mischievous by grabbing Anna's soccer ball?

source_en: Is Dad mad at Sophie now?
translation_es_ar: ¿Está el papá enojado con Sofía ahora?
back_translation: Is Dad angry with Sofia now?

source_en: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can’t find her shoe. Dad gets mad at Sophie, because she lost her shoe and now they are late for school.
translation_es_ar: Entonces Sofía está buscando su zapato por todas partes, pero no lo encuentra. Ahora el papá se ha enojado con Sofía porque perdió su zapato y van tarde para el colegio.
back_translation: So Sofia is looking everywhere for her shoe, but she can't find it. Now her dad is angry with Sofia because she lost her shoe and they're going to be late for school.

source_en: Teacher Sarah asks Brian, “Is there a storybook leftover, so Megan can have one?” Brian tells Teacher Sarah, “No, there is no storybook left. They are all being used right now.”
translation_es_ar: La profesora Sara le pregunta a Brian: "¿Queda algún libro de cuentos para que Megan pueda tener uno?" Brian le dice a la profesora Sara: "No, no queda ningún libro de cuentos. Todos se están usando."
back_translation: Professor Sara asks Brian, "Are there any storybooks left that Megan could have?" Brian tells Professor Sara, "No, there aren't any storybooks left. They're all in use."

source_en: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
translation_es_ar: Entonces, cuando Elián regrese, ¿dónde buscará primero su libro?
back_translation: So, when Elian returns, where will he look for his book first?

source_en: Kat comes back and tells George, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t buy you a basketball because the store didn’t have any.”
translation_es_ar: Catalina vuelve y le dice a Jorge: "Lo siento mucho, no pude comprarte una pelota de básquet porque no las vendían en la tienda".
back_translation: Catalina returns and says to Jorge: "I'm so sorry, I couldn't buy you a basketball because they weren't selling them at the store."

source_en: Does George know that Kat bought a storybook?
translation_es_ar: ¿Jorge sabe que Catalina compró un libro de cuentos?
back_translation: Does Jorge know that Catalina bought a book of stories?

source_en: Which stack of books was Mika talking about?
translation_es_ar: ¿A cuál torre de libros se refería Melisa?
back_translation: Which tower of books was Melisa referring to?

source_en: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
translation_es_ar: ¿Es justo que Mamá se enoje con Johan por haber perdido su camión?
back_translation: Is it fair for Mom to be angry with Johan for losing her truck?

source_en: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
translation_es_ar: Cuando Isabel se da cuenta de que Mamá está enojada con Johan, va al arenero, saca el juguete de la arena y se lo devuelve a Johan.
back_translation: When Isabel realizes that Mom is angry with Johan, she goes to the sandbox, takes the toy out of the sand and gives it back to Johan.

source_en: Kat didn’t hear George say that he wanted crayons. So Kat thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy shop, but then the shop owner says that they don’t have any basketballs! But they do have storybooks, so Kat buys a storybook for George instead.
translation_es_ar: Catalina no escuchó a Jorge decir que quería unos crayones, así que Catalina piensa que Jorge quiere una pelota de básquet. Catalina va a la juguetería, pero el dueño le dice que, aunque no tienen pelotas de básquet, sí tienen libros de cuentos. Catalina le compra un libro de cuentos a Jorge.
back_translation: Catalina didn't hear Jorge say he wanted crayons, so she thinks he wants a basketball. She goes to the toy store, but the owner tells her that although they don't have basketballs, they do have storybooks. Catalina buys Jorge a storybook.

source_en: While Kat is walking to the toy shop, George changes his mind and yells to Kat, “Actually, can I please have some crayons?” But Kat did not hear George ask for crayons.
translation_es_ar: Mientras Catalina caminaba a la juguetería, Jorge cambió de opinión y le gritó a Catalina: "En realidad, ¿me comprás unos crayones, por favor?". Pero Catalina no escuchó a Jorge pedir los crayones.
back_translation: As Catalina walked to the toy store, Jorge changed his mind and called out to her, "Actually, will you buy me some crayons, please?" But Catalina didn't hear Jorge ask for the crayons.

source_en: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
back_translation: Is Johan angry with Isabel now?

source_en: Is Dad mad at James now?
translation_es_ar: ¿Está el papá enojado con Jaime ahora?
back_translation: Is Dad angry with Jaime now?

source_en: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside-down, so that it looks like a cup!
translation_es_ar: Marco dibuja una colina para decirle a la mamá que quiere leer el libro sobre montañas. Pero cuando Marco le da el dibujo a mamá, ella lo mira al revés, ¡y entonces parece una taza!
back_translation: Marco draws a hill to tell his mom he wants to read the book about mountains. But when Marco gives the drawing to his mom, she looks at it upside down, and then it looks like a cup!

source_en: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
translation_es_ar: Mamá llega a casa y le dice a Sam que acaba de pasar por la tienda. "¿Venden camisas?" pregunta Sam. "No", dice Mamá, "solo venden zapatos". "Probablemente ahora María va a comprar zapatos en la tienda", dice Sam.
back_translation: Mom gets home and tells Sam she just passed by the store. "Do they sell shirts?" Sam asks. "No," says Mom, "they only sell shoes." "Maria's probably going to buy shoes at the store now," says Sam.

source_en: Now, when Allie comes in from outside, where will she look first for her pencil?
translation_es_ar: Ahora, cuando Alejandra vuelva de afuera, ¿dónde buscará primero su lápiz?
back_translation: Now, when Alejandra returns from abroad, where will she look for her pencil first?

source_en: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
translation_es_ar: Alex, Isabel y John están jugando un juego en el parque. En este juego uno de los niños se esconde, pero antes de esconderse, debe dibujar una pista en el arenero para que los otros puedan encontrarlo.
back_translation: Alex, Isabel, and John are playing a game in the park. In this game, one of the children hides, but before hiding, they must draw a clue in the sandbox so the others can find them.

source_en: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby reaching for that soccer ball?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se siente Anna cuando Roberto agarra esa pelota?
back_translation: How do you think Anna feels when Roberto grabs that ball?

source_en: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny means to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Johnny goes to hide behind the flower bush.
translation_es_ar: John decide esconderse detrás de una planta con flores. Él dibuja una pista en la arena. Pero aunque John quiere dibujar la planta con flores, ¡su dibujo parece una roca! Al terminar su dibujo, John se va a esconder detrás de la planta con flores.
back_translation: John decides to hide behind a flowering plant. He draws a clue in the sand. But even though John wants to draw the flowering plant, his drawing looks like a rock! After finishing his drawing, John goes to hide behind the flowering plant.

source_en: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
translation_es_ar: Luego entró Ana y puso su libro sobre el estante encima de los percheros. ¡El libro de Ana también es azul! Como Elián todavía está afuera jugando, no vio lo que hizo Ana.
back_translation: Then Ana came in and put her book on the shelf above the coat racks. Ana's book is blue too! Since Elián is still outside playing, he didn't see what Ana did.

source_en: Let’s see what she does. Oh look, here is Allie reaching for this pencil up on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie reaching for that pencil... the pencil that is Mike's!
translation_es_ar: Veamos lo que hace. Oh, mirá, aquí está Alejandra agarrando este lápiz de encima del mueble. Y ahora Miguel ve a Alejandra agarrando ese lápiz... ¡el lápiz que es de Miguel!
back_translation: Let's see what she does. Oh, look, here's Alejandra grabbing this pencil from on top of the cabinet. And now Miguel sees Alejandra grabbing that pencil... the pencil that belongs to Miguel!

source_en: What toy did Kat buy for George?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cuál juguete le compró Catalina a Jorge?
back_translation: Which toy did Catalina buy for Jorge?

source_en: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?
translation_es_ar: ¿Es justo que papá se enoje con Sofía por haber perdido su zapato?
back_translation: Is it fair for Dad to be angry with Sofia for losing her shoe?

source_en: This is Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house, while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium sized cup on the table, and a big cup that she put away up high, on the shelf.
translation_es_ar: Ella es Carla. Hace un rato, la mamá de Carla limpiaba la casa mientras Carla observaba. La mamá dejó tres tazas en la cocina: hay una taza pequeña en la barra, una taza mediana en la mesa y una taza grande en un estante que está muy alto.
back_translation: This is Carla. A little while ago, Carla's mom was cleaning the house while Carla watched. Her mom left three mugs in the kitchen: a small mug on the counter, a medium mug on the table, and a large mug on a very high shelf.

source_en: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for that soccer ball... the soccer ball that is Anna's!
translation_es_ar: Veamos lo que hace. Oh, mirá, aquí está Roberto agarrando la pelota de fútbol que está en la mesa. Y ahora Anna ve a Roberto buscando la pelota... ¡la pelota que es de Anna!
back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh, look, here's Roberto grabbing the soccer ball that's on the table. And now Anna sees Roberto reaching for the ball... the ball that belongs to Anna!

source_en: (1) Not able on their own (Requires a lot of support)
translation_es_ar: (1) No puede por sí mismo (necesita mucho apoyo)
back_translation: (1) Cannot do it on his own (needs a lot of support)

source_en: How do you think Mike feels about Allie reaching for that pencil?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se siente Miguel cuando Alejandra intenta agarrar ese lápiz?
back_translation: How do you think Miguel feels when Alejandra tries to grab that pencil?

source_en: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
translation_es_ar: Veamos lo que hace Elián. Oh, mirá, Elián está agarrando el libro que está sobre el estante. Y ahora Ana ve a Elián agarrando ese libro... ¡el libro que es de Ana!
back_translation: Let's see what Elián does. Oh, look, Elián is grabbing the book on the shelf. And now Ana sees Elián grabbing that book... the book that belongs to Ana!

source_en: Where will Madison look first for her book?
back_translation: Where will Marisol look for her book first?

source_en: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look first for his soccer ball?
translation_es_ar: Ahora, cuando Roberto vuelva de entrar, ¿dónde buscará primero su balón de fútbol?
back_translation: Now, when Roberto comes back from going in, where will he look for his soccer ball first?

source_en: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
translation_es_ar: Ahora, es el momento de leer y Marisol quiere su libro.
back_translation: Now it's time to read and Marisol wants her book.

source_en: Katie and Dad just walked in and Katie asks her dad to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad, “I want the big cup!”
translation_es_ar: Carla y Papá acaban de entrar y Carla le pide a su papá que le dé una taza. Carla le dice a su papá "¡quiero la taza grande!".
back_translation: Carla and Dad have just come in, and Carla asks her dad for a cup. Carla tells her dad, "I want the big cup!"

source_en: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.
translation_es_ar: Este es Marco. Marco está jugando hoy un juego un poco loco en el que no dice ninguna palabra en todo el día. En vez de hablar, está haciendo dibujos. Marco está en la biblioteca, decidiendo qué libro le gustaría leer. La mamá le muestra a Marco dos libros: uno sobre tazas y otro sobre montañas.
back_translation: This is Marco. Marco is playing a slightly crazy game today where he doesn't say a single word all day. Instead of talking, he's drawing pictures. Marco is in the library, deciding which book he'd like to read. His mom shows Marco two books: one about cups and one about mountains.

source_en: And then she went outside to play, see? Here’s Allie playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Allie’s yellow pencil fell down from on top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, see?
translation_es_ar: Y luego salió a jugar, ¿ves? Aquí está Alejandra jugando afuera. Y mientras estaba afuera jugando, el lápiz de color amarillo de Alejandra se cayó del estante y quedó detrás del mueble de las mochilas, ¿ves?
back_translation: And then she went outside to play, see? Here's Alejandra playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Alejandra's yellow colored pencil fell off the shelf and landed behind the backpack cabinet, see?

source_en: Instructions: Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live. To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs. To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job. The further to the right you are on the line, the closer you are to the people at the very top; the further to the left you are, the closer you are to the people at the very bottom.Where would you place yourself on this line?Move the slider to where you think you stand at this time in your life relative to other people in your country.
translation_es_ar: Instrucciones: Piense que esta línea representa la situación de la gente en el país en el que vive. A la derecha están las personas más acomodadas: las que tienen más dinero, más educación y los trabajos más respetados. A la izquierda están las personas que están en peor situación: las que tienen menos dinero, menos educación, los trabajos menos respetados o ningún trabajo. Cuanto más a la derecha se encuentre en la línea, más cerca estará de la gente que más tiene; cuanto más a la izquierda, más cerca estará de la gente que menos tiene.¿Dónde se situaría usted en esta línea?Mueva y ubique el círculo sobre la recta donde usted crea que encontrarse en este momento de su vida en relación con otras personas de su país.
back_translation: Instructions: Imagine this line represents the situation of people in the country where you live. To the right are the most affluent people: those with more money, more education, and the most respected jobs. To the left are the least well-off people: those with less money, less education, the least respected jobs, or no job at all. The further to the right you are on the line, the closer you are to the people who have the most; the further to the left, the closer you are to the people who have the least. Where would you place yourself on this line? Move and position the circle on the line where you think you are at this moment in your life in relation to other people in your country.

source_en: Mika’s mom just walked in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where the book is, and tells mom, “The book is in the small stack!”
translation_es_ar: La madre de Melisa acaba de entrar. La madre le pide a Melisa uno de los libros. Melisa recuerda dónde está ese libro y le dice a su mamá: "¡El libro está en la torre pequeña!".
back_translation: Melisa's mother has just come in. Her mother asks Melisa for one of the books. Melisa remembers where the book is and tells her mother, "The book is in the little tower!"

source_en: Teacher Sarah tells all of the kids to take one storybook from the bag that she brought. There is one storybook for every kid.
translation_es_ar: La profesora Sara le dice a todos sus estudiantes que agarren un libro de cuentos de la bolsa que trajo. Hay un libro de cuentos para cada estudiante.
back_translation: Professor Sara tells all her students to take a storybook from the bag she brought. There is one storybook for each student.

source_en: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
translation_es_ar: Por eso, Johan mira por todas partes y no encuentra su camión de juguete. Mamá se enoja con Johan porque perdió el camión.
back_translation: That's why Johan looks everywhere and can't find his toy truck. Mom gets angry with Johan because he lost the truck.

source_en: Megan is sad that she doesn’t have a storybook, and asks Teacher Sarah, "is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says, “I’m so sorry Megan, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used right now.”
translation_es_ar: Megan está triste porque no tiene un libro de cuentos y le pregunta a la profesora Sara: "¿Queda algún libro de cuentos para mí?" La profesora Sara le dice: "Lo siento mucho Megan, pero no quedan libros de cuentos, todos están en uso."
back_translation: Megan is sad because she doesn't have a storybook and asks teacher Sara, "Are there any storybooks left for me?" Teacher Sara tells her, "I'm very sorry, Megan, but there are no storybooks left; they are all in use."

source_en: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se sentiría Ana si no hubiera visto a Elián agarrar el libro?
back_translation: How do you think Ana would have felt if she hadn't seen Elián grab the book?

source_en: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se siente Ana cuando Elián agarra ese libro?
back_translation: How do you think Ana feels when Elián picks up that book?

source_en: Then Bobby’s sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn’t see what Anna was doing.
translation_es_ar: Entonces entra Anna, la hermana de Roberto. Anna también tiene una pelota de fútbol. Anna pone su pelota en la mesa. Roberto todavía está afuera jugando, así que no ve lo que hace Anna.
back_translation: Then Anna, Roberto's sister, comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball. Anna puts her ball on the table. Roberto is still outside playing, so he doesn't see what Anna does.

source_en: How do you think Anna would feel if she had not seen Bobby reaching for the soccer ball?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se sentiría Anna si no hubiera visto a Roberto intentando agarrar la pelota?
back_translation: How do you think Anna would feel if she hadn't seen Roberto trying to catch the ball?

source_en: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
translation_es_ar: ¿Podés ayudarla a Alejandra a encontrar su lápiz? ¿Está encima del estante o detrás del mueble de mochilas?
back_translation: Can you help Alejandra find her pencil? Is it on the shelf or behind the backpack cabinet?

source_en: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.
translation_es_ar: El papá les dice a Jaime y a Sofía que se preparen para ir al colegio. El papá les dice que se pongan los zapatos.
back_translation: The father tells Jaime and Sofia to get ready for school. The father tells them to put on their shoes.

source_en: When James sees that Dad is mad at Sophie, he goes to the toy box and gets the shoe, and gives it back to Sophie.
translation_es_ar: Cuando Jaime ve que papá está enojado con Sofía, va a la caja de juguetes, agarra el zapato y se lo devuelve a Sofía.
back_translation: When Jaime sees that his dad is angry with Sofia, he goes to the toy box, grabs the shoe, and gives it back to Sofia.

source_en: Should Bobby get in trouble with their mom for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
translation_es_ar: ¿Debería Roberto estar en problemas con su madre por agarrar la pelota de fútbol de Anna?
back_translation: Should Roberto be in trouble with his mother for taking Anna's soccer ball?

source_en: How do you think Mike would feel if he had not seen Allie reaching for the pencil?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo creés que se sentiría Miguel si no hubiera visto a Alejandra intentar agarrar el lápiz?
back_translation: How do you think Miguel would feel if he hadn't seen Alejandra trying to grab the pencil?

source_en: This morning when she came to school, Allie put her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.
translation_es_ar: Esta mañana, cuando vino a la escuela, Alejandra puso su lápiz de color amarillo en el estante, sobre el mueble de las mochilas.
back_translation: This morning, when she came to school, Alejandra put her yellow colored pencil on the shelf, above the backpack cabinet.

source_en: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?
translation_es_ar: Cuando Alex e Isabel vean esta pista, ¿dónde buscarán primero a John? ¿Detrás de la planta con flores o detrás de la roca?
back_translation: When Alex and Isabel see this clue, where will they look for John first? Behind the flowering plant or behind the rock?

source_en: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy shop across the street. Kat decides to go buy some new toys at the toy shop. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George says he would like a new basketball.
translation_es_ar: Jorge y Catalina están jugando juntos. Miran afuera y ven una juguetería nueva al otro lado de la calle. Catalina decide ir a comprar juguetes a la juguetería. Catalina le pregunta a Jorge cuál juguete le gustaría tener y Jorge dice que le gustaría una pelota de básquet nueva.
back_translation: Jorge and Catalina are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy store across the street. Catalina decides to go buy toys at the toy store. Catalina asks Jorge which toy he would like, and Jorge says he would like a new basketball.

source_en: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike’s pencil is also yellow! But Allie is still outside playing, so she didn’t see what Mike was doing.
translation_es_ar: Entonces entra Miguel y Miguel pone su lápiz encima del mueble de las mochilas. El lápiz de Miguel también es de color amarillo. Pero Alejandra todavía está fuera jugando, así que no vio lo que Miguel estaba haciendo.
back_translation: Then Miguel comes in and puts his pencil on top of the backpack rack. Miguel's pencil is also yellow. But Alejandra is still outside playing, so she didn't see what Miguel was doing.

source_en: What does George think Kat bought at the toy shop?
translation_es_ar: ¿Qué cree Jorge que Catalina compró en la juguetería?
back_translation: What does Jorge think Catalina bought at the toy store?

source_en: This is Mika. Mika’s mom owns a bookshop, and sometimes Mika helps out. Earlier today, Mika was organizing books on tables and shelves. Mika put a very large stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.
translation_es_ar: Esta es Melisa. La madre de Melisa tiene una librería y Melisa a veces la ayuda. Hace un rato, Melisa estaba organizando unos libros en las mesas y biblioteca. Melisa puso una torre muy grande de libros azules en el escritorio, una torre mediana de libros rojos en la mesa y una torre pequeña de libros amarillos en la biblioteca.
back_translation: This is Melisa. Melisa's mother owns a bookstore, and Melisa sometimes helps out. A little while ago, Melisa was arranging some books on the tables and bookshelves. Melisa put a very tall stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the bookshelf.

source_en: has your child had FREQUENT or CHRONIC difficulty with any of the following?"
translation_es_ar: DURANTE LOS ÚLTIMOS 12 MESES, ¿ha tenido su niño(a) dificultades FRECUENTES o CRÓNICAS en alguno de los siguientes aspectos?
back_translation: During the past 12 months, has your child had frequent or chronic difficulties in any of the following areas?

source_en: Ignores a preferred, fun activity (e.g., playing) when asked to complete an assigned task (e.g., cleaning room).
translation_es_ar: Ignora una actividad preferida y divertida (p. ej., jugar) cuando se le pide que complete una tarea asignada (p. ej., limpiar la habitación).
back_translation: Ignores a preferred and enjoyable activity (e.g., playing) when asked to complete an assigned task (e.g., cleaning the room).

source_en: Answers questions or tells a story without getting distracted by small details and/or losing train of thought.
translation_es_ar: Responde a preguntas o cuenta una historia sin distraerse con pequeños detalles ni perder el hilo de sus pensamientos.
back_translation: Answer questions or tell a story without getting distracted by small details or losing track of your thoughts.

source_en: Waits turn to speak (e.g., does not interrupt others, does not blurt out answers, thinks before speaking).
translation_es_ar: Espera su turno para hablar (p. ej., no interrumpe a los demás, no apresura sus respuestas, piensa antes de hablar).
back_translation: Waits his turn to speak (e.g., does not interrupt others, does not rush his answers, thinks before speaking).

source_en: Stops an undesirable behavior when asked (e.g., stops fighting with sibling when asked by parent, stops misbehaving in the household).
translation_es_ar: Detiene un comportamiento indeseable cuando se lo piden (p. ej., deja de pelearse con un hermano cuando se lo piden sus padres, deja de portarse mal en casa).
back_translation: Stops undesirable behavior when asked (e.g., stops fighting with a sibling when asked by parents, stops misbehaving at home).

source_en: Stops playing or doing something fun when asked (e.g., stops playing with friends when parent asks, stops watching TV when parent asks).
translation_es_ar: Deja de jugar o de hacer algo divertido cuando se lo piden (p. ej., deja de jugar con sus amigos o deja de ver la televisión cuando se lo piden sus padres).
back_translation: Stops playing or doing something fun when asked to (e.g., stops playing with friends or stops watching television when asked by parents).

source_en: Waits for their turn to act (e.g., waits patiently in line at a grocery store or when sharing a toy with sibling).
translation_es_ar: Espera su turno para actuar (p. ej., espera pacientemente en la fila del supermercado o cuando comparte un juguete con su hermano).
back_translation: Waits his turn to act (e.g., waits patiently in the supermarket queue or when sharing a toy with his brother).

source_en: Stops and thinks before acting (e.g., does not run out in front of a car, does not grab things they shouldn't).
translation_es_ar: Se detiene y piensa antes de actuar (p. ej., no se lanza corriendo delante de un vehículo, no toma un objeto que no debería).
back_translation: He stops and thinks before acting (e.g., he doesn't run in front of a vehicle, he doesn't pick up an object he shouldn't).

source_en: Completes activities that require multiple steps (e.g., fetching multiple things in home or store/market, setting the table, cleaning a room by putting several things away).
translation_es_ar: Concluye las actividades que requieren varios pasos (p. ej., ir a buscar varias cosas a la casa o al mercado, poner la mesa, limpiar una habitación guardando varias cosas).
back_translation: Complete the activities that require several steps (e.g., going to get several things from the house or the market, setting the table, cleaning a room while putting away several things).

source_en: Completes activities that require remembering lengthy instructions (e.g., rules of a game, household chores, cooking recipe).
translation_es_ar: Completa actividades que requieren recordar instrucciones largas (p. ej., reglas de un juego, tareas domésticas, receta de cocina).
back_translation: Complete activities that require remembering long instructions (e.g., rules of a game, household chores, cooking recipe).

source_en: Communicates in an organized way (e.g., retells the correct sequence of the events, explains how a game works so it is easy to understand).
translation_es_ar: Se comunica de forma organizada (p. ej., vuelve a contar la secuencia correcta de los acontecimientos, explica cómo funciona un juego para que sea fácil de entender).
back_translation: He/She communicates in an organized manner (e.g., retells the correct sequence of events, explains how a game works so that it is easy to understand).

source_en: Finishes an assigned task that is repetitive (e.g., picking up toys, putting away laundry).
translation_es_ar: Concluye una tarea repetitiva asignada (p. ej., recoger los juguetes, guardar la ropa).
back_translation: Completes an assigned repetitive task (e.g., picking up toys, putting away clothes).

source_en: Completes age-appropriate numerical mental calculation (e.g., adds prices of goods, calculates time, how much they are older than someone else).
translation_es_ar: Realiza cálculos mentales numéricos apropiados para su edad (p. ej., suma precios de productos, calcula el tiempo, la diferencia de edad que hay entre él/ella y otra persona).
back_translation: Performs age-appropriate numerical mental calculations (e.g., adds up prices of products, calculates time, the age difference between himself/herself and another person).

source_en: Remembers and considers all options when making a choice (e.g., what to do when they get stuck on a household task or face a problem, food options).
translation_es_ar: Recuerda y considera todas las opciones a la hora de elegir (p. ej., qué hacer cuando se complica una tarea doméstica o se enfrenta a un problema, qué comida elegir).
back_translation: Remember and consider all options when choosing (e.g., what to do when a household chore becomes complicated or you face a problem, what food to choose).

source_en: Remembers physical directions, patterns, and where things are (e.g., knows walking routes, finds things in a grocery store, good at searching for a lost item or playing hide-and-seek).
translation_es_ar: Recuerda direcciones, patrones y ubicación de las cosas (p. ej., conoce las rutas para caminar, encuentra las cosas en una tienda de comestibles, es hábil buscando un objeto perdido o jugando al escondite).
back_translation: Remembers directions, patterns, and the location of things (e.g., knows walking routes, finds things in a grocery store, is skilled at finding a lost object or playing hide-and-seek).

source_en: Comes up with new ways for solving challenges (e.g., repurposes materials or toys, comes up with a new way to build a tower or fort after it collapses, solves a puzzle in a new way, comes up with a new strategy to complete a chore).
translation_es_ar: Inventa nuevas formas de resolver problemas (p. ej., reutiliza materiales o juguetes, inventa una nueva forma de construir una torre o un castillo después de que se derrumba, resuelve un rompecabezas de una forma nueva, inventa una nueva estrategia para completar una tarea).
back_translation: Invent new ways to solve problems (e.g., reuse materials or toys, invent a new way to build a tower or castle after it collapses, solve a puzzle in a new way, invent a new strategy to complete a task).

source_en: Expresses themselves in a new way when not understood by others (e.g., tries different ways to communicate their needs and wants).
translation_es_ar: Se expresa de forma diferente cuando los demás no le entienden (p. ej., intenta comunicar sus necesidades y deseos de distintas maneras).
back_translation: He expresses himself differently when others do not understand him (e.g., he tries to communicate his needs and desires in different ways).

source_en: Adjusts when plans/schedules change (e.g., follows along when daily schedule changes, does not complain when unexpected sickness leads to canceling a family vacation).
translation_es_ar: Se adapta cuando cambian los planes u horarios (p. ej., se adapta cuando cambian los horarios, no se queja cuando una enfermedad inesperada obliga a cancelar las vacaciones familiares).
back_translation: He adapts when plans or schedules change (e.g., he adapts when schedules change, he doesn't complain when an unexpected illness forces the cancellation of the family vacation).

source_en: Understands conflicting perspectives/ideas (e.g., acknowledges a different point of view, accepts different ways of doing things, can see a situation from someone else’s perspective).
translation_es_ar: Entiende las posiciones o ideas contradictorias (p. ej., reconoce un punto de vista diferente, acepta distintas formas de hacer las cosas, puede ver una situación desde la perspectiva de otra persona).
back_translation: Understands contradictory positions or ideas (e.g., recognizes a different point of view, accepts different ways of doing things, can see a situation from another person's perspective).

source_en: Connects ideas/experiences to other ideas/experiences (e.g., identifies connections between books/movies and lived experiences, uses strategies learned at school to complete activities at home).
translation_es_ar: Conecta unas ideas y experiencias con otras ideas y experiencias (p. ej., identifica las conexiones entre libros o películas y experiencias vividas, utiliza estrategias aprendidas en la escuela para completar actividades en casa).
back_translation: Connect ideas and experiences with other ideas and experiences (e.g., identify connections between books or films and lived experiences, use strategies learned at school to complete activities at home).

source_en: Adapts behavior based on what is required by the situation (e.g., switches characters/roles while playing a game, changes behavior based on playtime or study time).
translation_es_ar: Adapta su comportamiento en función de lo que requiere la situación (p. ej., cambia de personaje o papel en un juego, cambia su comportamiento en función a que se encuentra en tiempo de juego o tiempo de estudio).
back_translation: Adapts their behavior according to what the situation requires (e.g., changes character or role in a game, changes their behavior depending on whether they are in play time or study time).

source_en: Identifies and gathers necessary materials before an activity (e.g., finds appropriate coat, shoes, hat before going outside; gathers lunch box, homework, and backpack before going to school).
translation_es_ar: Identifica y reúne los materiales necesarios antes de una actividad (p. ej., busca el abrigo, los zapatos o el sombrero adecuados antes de salir a la calle; recoge la lonchera, las tareas y la mochila antes de ir al colegio).
back_translation: Identify and gather the necessary materials before an activity (e.g., find the appropriate coat, shoes or hat before going outside; collect the lunchbox, homework and backpack before going to school).

source_en: Remains focused and engaged during lengthy adult-led activities (e.g., religious or performance event, family meal time) by listening carefully and contributing when appropriate.
translation_es_ar: Se mantiene concentrado e involucrado durante las actividades prolongadas dirigidas por adultos (p. ej., presentaciones o actos religiosos, comidas en familia), escuchando atentamente y participando apropiadamente.
back_translation: He remains focused and engaged during prolonged adult-led activities (e.g., presentations or religious services, family meals), listening attentively and participating appropriately.

source_en: Creates a strategy or plan for completing a task (e.g., chore, homework, puzzle).
translation_es_ar: Crea una estrategia o un plan para completar una tarea (p. ej., una tarea, los deberes, un rompecabezas).
back_translation: Create a strategy or plan to complete a task (e.g., a homework assignment, homework, a puzzle).

source_en: finishes homework on time and not at the last minute)."
translation_es_ar: Termina las tareas a tiempo (p. ej., termina los deberes a tiempo y no en el último minuto).
back_translation: Finish tasks on time (e.g., finish homework on time and not at the last minute).

source_en: Checks for mistakes before completing a task (e.g., reviews and corrects errors on class assignments).
translation_es_ar: Verifica si hay errores antes de completar una tarea (p. ej., revisa y corrige los errores en las tareas de clase).
back_translation: Check for errors before completing a task (e.g., review and correct errors in class assignments).

source_en: Begins plans or routines without prompting (e.g., takes an initiative to help a family member, starts daily household chores on their own).
translation_es_ar: Inicia actividades o rutinas sin que nadie se lo pida (p. ej., toma la iniciativa de ayudar a un miembro de la familia, empieza las tareas domésticas diarias por su cuenta).
back_translation: Initiates activities or routines without being asked (e.g., takes the initiative to help a family member, starts daily household chores on their own).

source_en: Negotiates and incorporates peers' suggestions without conflict or resistance (e.g., works with others to plan roles during pretend play, negotiates with sibling about how to complete chores together).
translation_es_ar: Negocia con sus compañeros e incorpora sus sugerencias evitando conflicto o resistencia (p. ej., trabaja con los otros para acordar los personajes que cada uno asume durante un juego de roles, negocia con un hermano cómo completar juntos las tareas del hogar).
back_translation: Negotiates with peers and incorporates their suggestions, avoiding conflict or resistance (e.g., works with others to agree on the roles each assumes during role-playing, negotiates with a sibling how to complete household chores together).

source_en: Remains focused and engaged during collaborative child-led activities (e.g., playing with siblings/peers).
translation_es_ar: Se mantiene concentrado e involucrado durante las actividades de colaboración dirigidas por niños (p. ej., jugando con sus hermanos o compañeros).
back_translation: He remains focused and engaged during child-led collaborative activities (e.g., playing with siblings or peers).

source_en: Persists on a difficult cognitive/learning task (e.g., homework) by trying to figure things out, asking questions, and not quitting.
translation_es_ar: Persiste en tareas con alta demanda cognitiva / de aprendizaje (p. ej., los deberes) tratando de resolver las cosas, haciendo preguntas, y no abandonando la actividad.
back_translation: Persists on tasks with high cognitive/learning demands (e.g., homework) by trying to work things out, asking questions, and not giving up on the activity.

source_en: Gets deeply engaged in an activity they choose for themselves (e.g., drawing, reading, cooking, building, sports, games).
translation_es_ar: Se involucra profundamente en una actividad elegida por él/ella (p. ej., dibujar, leer, cocinar, construir, hacer deporte, jugar).
back_translation: He/she becomes deeply involved in an activity of his/her choosing (e.g., drawing, reading, cooking, building, playing sports, playing games).

source_en: Ignores irrelevant activity/noise (e.g., crying sibling, TV, outside traffic) when working on an assigned task.
translation_es_ar: Ignora actividades y ruidos irrelevantes (p. ej., el llanto de un hermano, la televisión, el tráfico) cuando trabaja en una tarea asignada.
back_translation: Ignores irrelevant activities and noises (e.g., a sibling crying, television, traffic) when working on an assigned task.

source_en: Completes an assigned task before moving to a next task.
translation_es_ar: Termina la tarea asignada antes de pasar a la siguiente.
back_translation: Finish the assigned task before moving on to the next one.

source_en: Regains focus/focuses again on an assigned task when interrupted (e.g., family member asks an unrelated question or needs brief assistance).
translation_es_ar: Recupera la concentración o vuelve a centrarse en una tarea asignada cuando se le interrumpe (p. ej., un miembro de la familia hace una pregunta no relacionada o solicita ayuda).
back_translation: Regains concentration or refocuses on an assigned task when interrupted (e.g., a family member asks an unrelated question or requests help).

source_en: We are interested how often, independently, and easily your child shows each behavior when occasions call for it. Children who excel at a specific behavior should receive 4 (the highest rating), whereas most children will be between 3 and 2. Those who are still developing and need a lot of support should receive a rating of 1. 4 = Always on their own (No support needed)
translation_es_ar: Nos interesa saber con qué frecuencia, de forma independiente, y facilidad su niño(a) despliega estos comportamientos cuando la ocasión lo requiere. Los niños que sobresalen en un comportamiento específico deberían recibir una calificación de 4 (la puntuación más alta). La mayoría de niños recibirán calificaciones de 3 ó 2. Quienes aún están en desarrollo y requieren mucho apoyo deberían recibir una calificación de 1.4 = Siempre por sí mismo (no necesita apoyo) 3 = Generalmente por sí mismo (necesita poco apoyo o pocos recordatorios)2 = A veces por sí mismo (necesita apoyo moderado o recordatorios con frecuencia)1 = No puede por sí mismo (necesita mucho apoyo)
back_translation: We are interested in knowing how frequently, independently, and easily your child displays these behaviors when the occasion calls for it. Children who excel in a specific behavior should receive a rating of 4 (the highest score). Most children will receive ratings of 3 or 2. Those who are still developing and require a lot of support should receive a rating of 1. 4 = Always by themselves (no support needed) 3 = Usually by themselves (needs little support or few reminders) 2 = Sometimes by themselves (needs moderate support or frequent reminders) 1 = Cannot do it by themselves (needs a lot of support)

translation_es_ar: Medir o pesar cosas (por ejemplo, para cocinar)

back_translation: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.

source_en: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cuál juguete cree el papá que Emma quiere llevar a la escuela?
back_translation: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to take to school?

source_en: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?
translation_es_ar: ¿Emma sabe que su papá puso la pelota azul?
back_translation: Does Emma know that her dad put the blue ball in?

source_en: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cuál pelota cree Emma que puso su papá?
back_translation: Which ball does Emma think her dad put in?

source_en: What toy did Dad pack for Emma?
back_translation: Which toy did his dad give him?

source_en: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
translation_es_ar: ¿Podés ayudarla a Anna a encontrar su pelota de fútbol? ¿Está sobre la mesa o en el suelo?
back_translation: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

source_en: Sophie can’t find one of her shoes! She’s looking everywhere but she can't find it.
translation_es_ar: Sofía no encuentra uno de sus zapatos. Lo está buscando por todas partes, pero no lo encuentra.
back_translation: Sofia can't find one of her shoes. She's looking everywhere, but she can't find it.

source_en: Which stack of books will mom look in?
translation_es_ar: ¿En cuál torre de libros va a buscar la mamá?
back_translation: Which tower of books will Mom look in?

source_en: Mom looks in the wrong stack of books and can’t find the book that she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not finding the book she wanted?
translation_es_ar: La mamá busca en la torre de libros equivocada y no encuentra el libro que quería. ¿Cómo creés que se siente la mamá al no encontrar el libro que quería?
back_translation: The mother is looking in the wrong stack of books and can't find the book she wants. How do you think the mother feels about not finding the book she wants?

source_en: How do you think Mom would feel if she could find the book she wanted?
translation_es_ar: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría la mamá si pudiera encontrar el libro que quería?
back_translation: How do you think the mother would feel if she could find the book she wanted?

source_en: George is very happy to play with his new storybook.
translation_es_ar: Jorge está emocionado por leer su nuevo libro de cuentos.
back_translation: Jorge is excited to read his new book of stories.

source_en: And where is her book really?
back_translation: And where is his book, really?

source_en: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil box.
translation_es_ar: Aquí está Gabriel. Esta tarde en el colegio, Gabriel guardó su lápiz en su cartuchera.
back_translation: Here's Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil case.

source_en: So now it’s time for class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.
translation_es_ar: Es hora de ir a clase y Gabriel quiere su lápiz.
back_translation: It's time to go to class and Gabriel wants his pencil.

source_en: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?
back_translation: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?

source_en: And where is his pencil really?
back_translation: And where is his pencil, really?

source_en: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
translation_es_ar: Esta mañana, cuando vino a la escuela, Elián puso su libro sobre el estante encima de los percheros para los abrigos. El libro de Elián es azul.
back_translation: This morning, when he came to school, Elián put his book on the shelf above the coat racks. Elián's book is blue.

source_en: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
translation_es_ar: Y luego salió a jugar, ¿ves? Aquí está Elián jugando afuera. Mientras Elián estaba afuera jugando, su libro se cayó del estante y quedó en el piso, debajo de los abrigos, ¿ves?
back_translation: And then he went outside to play, see? Here's Elián playing outside. While Elián was outside playing, his book fell off the shelf and landed on the floor, under the coats, see?

source_en: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
translation_es_ar: ¿Puedes ayudar a Elián a encontrar su libro? ¿Está sobre el estante o debajo de los abrigos?
back_translation: Can you help Elián find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

source_en: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
translation_es_ar: Johan, Isabel e Iván están jugando. El juego es el siguiente: Uno de los niños se esconde, pero debe dibujar una pista en el arenero que permita a los otros niños encontrarlo.
back_translation: Johan, Isabel, and Iván are playing. The game is as follows: One of the children hides, but must draw a clue in the sandbox that will allow the other children to find him.

source_en: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
translation_es_ar: Entonces, Iván va primero. Dibuja esta pista en el arenero y se esconde.
back_translation: So, Ivan goes first. He draws this clue in the sandbox and hides.

source_en: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
translation_es_ar: Ya se acabaron los juegos y es hora de volver a casa. Mamá les dice a los niños que busquen todos sus juguetes.
back_translation: The games are over and it's time to go home. Mom tells the children to gather all their toys.

source_en: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
translation_es_ar: Johan trajo su camión de juguete al parque, pero ahora no lo encuentra. Lo busca por todas partes, pero no puede encontrarlo.
back_translation: Johan brought his toy truck to the park, but now he can't find it. He looks everywhere, but he can't find it.

source_en: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
translation_es_ar: Johan no encuentra su camión porque antes, cuando nadie miraba, Isabel agarró el camión de juguete y lo enterró en la arena.
back_translation: Johan can't find his truck because earlier, when nobody was looking, Isabel grabbed the toy truck and buried it in the sand.

source_en: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
translation_es_ar: Sam y María están jugando juntos. Cuando miran hacia afuera ven una tienda nueva al otro lado de la calle. María le dice a Sam: "Voy a ir a comprar camisas nuevas para nosotros" y se va.
back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. When they look outside, they see a new store across the street. Maria says to Sam, "I'm going to go buy some new shirts for us," and off she goes.

source_en: On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
translation_es_ar: Caminando de regreso, María se encuentra con su padre. Ella le dice "Acabo de comprar unas medias. Voy a compartirlas con mi hermano Sam. Es una sorpresa"."Es muy amable de tu parte", dice Papá. Luego le pregunta a María: "¿Sam sabe qué le compraste?".
back_translation: Walking back, Maria runs into her father. She tells him, "I just bought some tights. I'm going to share them with my brother Sam. It's a surprise." "That's very kind of you," says Dad. Then he asks Maria, "Does Sam know what you bought him?"

source_en: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
translation_es_ar: Entonces Papá pregunta: "¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?".
back_translation: Then Dad asks, "What does Sam think they sell at the store?"

source_en: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
translation_es_ar: Sam está muy feliz por recibir sus medias nuevas.
back_translation: Sam is very happy to receive his new tights.

source_en: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
translation_es_ar: ¿María sabe que en la tienda venden zapatos?
back_translation: Does Maria know that they sell shoes in the store?

source_en: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria bought stockings?

source_en: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
translation_es_ar: ¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?
back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?
What does Maria say to Dad?
What does Maria say to Dad?

source_en: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
translation_es_ar: ¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?
back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?

source_en: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
translation_es_ar: Aquí está Diana. Esta mañana en el colegio, Diana metió su juguete en este cajón porque no quería que nadie lo encontrara.
back_translation: Here's Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer because she didn't want anyone to find it.

source_en: But while Diana was outside, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer, to inside the desk.
translation_es_ar: Pero mientras Diana estaba afuera, ¡alguien lo encontró! Y lo movió del cajón al escritorio.
back_translation: But while Diana was out, someone found it! And moved it from the drawer to the desk.

source_en: So now it’s playtime and Diana wants her toy.
translation_es_ar: Así que ahora es hora de jugar y Diana quiere su juguete.
back_translation: So now it's time to play and Diana wants her toy.

source_en: Where will Diana look for her toy?
back_translation: Where will Diana look for her toy?

source_en: And where is her toy really?
back_translation: And where is his toy, really?

source_en: Nice work! Here is a new story.
translation_es_ar: ¡Bien hecho! Ahora vamos con una nueva historia.
back_translation: Well done! Now let's move on to a new story.

source_en: Add the numbers and choose the correct answer.
translation_es_ar: Sumá los números y elegí la respuesta correcta.
back_translation: Add up the numbers and choose the correct answer.

translation_es_ar: Detrás del mueble de las mochilas
Detrás de la planta con flores

source_en: These questions ask you about how you feel at school and some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think.
translation_es_ar: Estas preguntas te preguntan cómo te sientes en la escuela y sobre algunas de las cosas que hacés en la escuela. Elegí la respuesta que mejor describe lo que pensás.
back_translation: These questions ask you how you feel about school and some of the things you do there. Choose the answer that best describes your thoughts.

source_en: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture! The grownup helping you will press the button.
translation_es_ar: En este juego de números, dirás cuántas cosas hay en la imagen. El adulto que te está ayudando presionará el botón.
back_translation: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture. The adult helping you will press the button.

source_en: This time, you will choose the button with the right number!
translation_es_ar: ¡Esta vez, elegirás el botón con el número correcto!
back_translation: This time, you'll choose the button with the correct number!

source_en: I have SERIOUS CONCERNS about these data (e.g., the child did not seem to understand the task, was frequently distracted/interrupted, etc.)
translation_es_ar: Tengo GRANDES PREOCUPACIONES sobre estos datos (p. ej., el niño no parecía entender la tarea, se distrajo o interrumpió con frecuencia, etc.)
back_translation: I have GREAT CONCERNS about this data (e.g., the child did not seem to understand the task, was frequently distracted or interrupted, etc.)

source_en: I feel OK about these data (e.g., the child seemed to understand the task pretty well, only experienced a few distractions/interruptions, etc.)
translation_es_ar: Me siento bien con estos datos (p. ej., el niño parecía entender la tarea bastante bien, solo tuvo algunas distracciones/interrupciones, etc.)
back_translation: I feel good about this data (e.g., the child seemed to understand the task quite well, only had a few distractions/interruptions, etc.)

source_en: I feel GOOD about these data (e.g., the child clearly understood the task, had very few (if any) distractions/ interruptions, etc.)
translation_es_ar: Me siento BIEN con estos datos (p. ej., el niño entendió claramente la tarea, tuvo muy pocas (o ninguna) distracciones/interrupciones, etc.)
back_translation: I feel GOOD about this data (e.g., the child clearly understood the task, had very few (or no) distractions/interruptions, etc.)

source_en: That's not quite right. Please try again.
translation_es_ar: Eso no está del todo bien. ¡Intentalo de nuevo!
back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again!

source_en: This is the flower game. Here's how you play it.
translation_es_ar: Este es el juego de las flores. Las reglas son las siguientes.
back_translation: This is the flower game. The rules are as follows.

source_en: When you see a flower, press the button on the opposite side.
translation_es_ar: Cuando veas una flor, presioná el botón del lado opuesto.
back_translation: When you see a flower, press the button on the opposite side.

source_en: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.
translation_es_ar: La flor está en el lado izquierdo. Presioná el botón derecho.
back_translation: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.

source_en: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.
translation_es_ar: Cuando veas una FLOR, presioná el botón en el lado OPUESTO.
back_translation: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

source_en: Please use a tablet in landscape mode, or a desktop computer or a laptop to complete the activities.
translation_es_ar: Por favor utilizá una tablet en modo horizontal, una computadora de escritorio o una laptop para que las actividades se puedan visualizar correctamente.
back_translation: Please use a tablet in landscape mode, a desktop computer, or a laptop so that the activities can be viewed correctly.

source_en: Click the button below or press ANY KEY to continue
translation_es_ar: Hacé clic en el botón de abajo o tocá CUALQUIER TECLA para continuar
back_translation: Click the button below or press ANY KEY to continue

translation_es_ar: Cambiar al modo de pantalla completa

source_en: Hi! We are excited to have you play some games with us today!
translation_es_ar: ¡Hola! ¡Estamos encantados de que juegues hoy con nosotros!
back_translation: Hello! We're delighted that you're playing with us today!

source_en: First, you get to choose a buddy to play along with you. As you complete the different games, you will get to pick an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your buddy.
translation_es_ar: En primer lugar, tenés que elegir a un amigo para que juegue con vos. A medida que completes los diferentes juegos, podrás elegir un accesorio como un sombrero o unos anteojos para decorar a tu amigo.
back_translation: First, you need to choose a friend to play with you. As you complete the different games, you can choose an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your friend.

source_en: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.
translation_es_ar: Ahora que ya tenés a tu amigo, queremos explicarte cómo funcionan los juegos.
back_translation: Now that you have your friend, we want to explain how the games work.

source_en: During the games you will need to listen to instructions so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is the way you like it. If you need to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button up in the corner of your screen.
translation_es_ar: Durante los juegos tendrás que escuchar las instrucciones, así que asegurate de que los altavoces están encendidos y el volumen está a tu gusto. Si necesitás volver a escuchar las instrucciones, presioná el botón del altavoz situado en la esquina superior de la pantalla.
back_translation: During gameplay, you'll need to listen to the instructions, so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is at your liking. If you need to hear the instructions again, press the speaker button in the upper corner of the screen.

source_en: You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can pick the way that works best for you.If you have any questions or need help getting started, please ask the adult who is nearby to help you.
translation_es_ar: Podés elegir tus respuestas de diferentes maneras dependiendo del tipo de tablet o computadora que estés utilizando. Podés utilizar un mouse o un panel táctil para hacer clic en tu elección, podés utilizar las teclas de flecha del teclado o podés tocar la pantalla si utilizás una tablet. Podés elegir la forma que más te convenga.Si tenés alguna duda o necesitás ayuda para empezar, pedí ayuda al adulto que esté cerca.
back_translation: You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click on your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch the screen if you are using a tablet. You can choose the method that suits you best. If you have any questions or need help getting started, ask an adult nearby for assistance.

source_en: If you want to use your keyboard to answer a question, press the arrow key shown next to your choice.
translation_es_ar: Si querés usar el teclado para responder una pregunta, hacé click en la flecha que ves al lado de la opción que querés elegir.
back_translation: If you want to use the keyboard to answer a question, click on the arrow next to the option you want to choose.

source_en: Looks like this is a little tricky! Let’s review the instructions.
translation_es_ar: ¡Parece que esto es un poco complicado! Repasemos las instrucciones.
back_translation: This seems a bit complicated! Let's go over the instructions.

source_en: Please rotate your device for the best view of the activities.
translation_es_ar: Por favor utilizá la tablet en modo horizontal para que las actividades se puedan visualizar correctamente.
back_translation: Please use the tablet in landscape mode so that the activities can be viewed correctly.

source_en: Nice job with the practice! Let's try some more on your own.
translation_es_ar: ¡Buen trabajo en la práctica! Ahora intentá hacer unos ensayos por tu cuenta.
back_translation: Great job on the practice! Now try doing some trials on your own.

source_en: This is the heart game. Here's how you play it.
translation_es_ar: Este es el juego del corazón. Las reglas son las siguientes.
back_translation: This is the game of the heart. The rules are as follows.

source_en: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.
translation_es_ar: Cuando veas un corazón, presioná el botón del mismo lado.
back_translation: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.

source_en: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.
translation_es_ar: El corazón está en el lado derecho. Presioná el botón derecho.
back_translation: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.

source_en: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
translation_es_ar: ¡Recordá! Cuando veas un CORAZÓN, presioná el botón del MISMO lado.
back_translation: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
Try to keep up with the rhythm!

source_en: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
back_translation: If you make a mistake, keep going!

source_en: Great job! You completed the game!
back_translation: Well done, you finished the game!

source_en: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!
translation_es_ar: Esta vez el juego irá más rápido. No te dirá si la respuesta es correcta o no. ¡Tratá de seguir el ritmo!
back_translation: This time the game will be faster. It won't tell you if the answer is correct or not. Try to keep up!

source_en: Try to answer as fast as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!
translation_es_ar: Intentá responder lo más rápido que puedas sin cometer errores. Si cometés un error, ¡seguí adelante!
back_translation: Try to answer as quickly as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!

source_en: Now, we're going to play a game with hearts and flowers.
translation_es_ar: Ahora, vamos a jugar un juego con corazones y flores.
back_translation: Now, let's play a game with hearts and flowers.

source_en: That's not quite right. Please try again.
translation_es_ar: Eso no está del todo bien. ¡Intentalo de nuevo!
back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again!

source_en: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
translation_es_ar: Imaginá que vas camino a la escuela y llevás puestos tus zapatos nuevos. Te gustan mucho tus zapatos nuevos y es la primera vez que los usás.
back_translation: Imagine you're walking to school wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes, and it's the first time you've worn them.

source_en: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
translation_es_ar: De repente, un chico te choca por detrás. Te tropezás y caés en un charco de barro y tus zapatos nuevos se ensucian de barro.
back_translation: Suddenly, a boy bumps into you from behind. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle, and your new shoes get covered in mud.

source_en: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
translation_es_ar: ¿Creés que el chico te chocó a propósito o por accidente?
back_translation: Do you think the boy hit you on purpose or by accident?

source_en: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
translation_es_ar: Ahora elegí cuál de estas tres opciones harías vos:
back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

source_en: push the boy in the mud
back_translation: push the boy into the mud

source_en: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
translation_es_ar: Imaginá que estás en el patio de recreo. Vos y otros niños están haciendo una carrera. Un niño está parado a un lado, haciendo rebotar una pelota de básquet.
back_translation: Imagine you're in the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. One kid is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.

source_en: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
translation_es_ar: De repente, el chico hace rebotar la pelota y rueda bajo tus pies, haciéndote caer. Te raspás la rodilla, y alguien más gana la carrera.
back_translation: Suddenly, the boy bounces the ball and it rolls under your feet, making you fall. You scrape your knee, and someone else wins the race.

source_en: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?
translation_es_ar: ¿Creés que el chico te hizo caer a propósito o por accidente?
back_translation: Do you think the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?

source_en: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
translation_es_ar: Ahora elegí cuál de estas tres opciones harías vos:
back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

source_en: go to another area of the playground
translation_es_ar: ir a otra zona del patio de recreo
back_translation: go to another area of the playground

source_en: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.
translation_es_ar: Imaginá que estás trabajando en una tarea en tu escritorio.
back_translation: Imagine you are working on a task at your desk.

source_en: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.
translation_es_ar: Te levantás para sacarle punta a tu lápiz y, de regreso a tu escritorio, vas detrás de un niño que camina justo delante de vos. El niño pasa por tu escritorio antes de que vos llegues.
back_translation: You get up to sharpen your pencil and, on your way back to your desk, you follow behind a child walking directly in front of you. The child passes your desk before you reach it.

source_en: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
translation_es_ar: De repente, el chico tira todos los papeles que estaban en tu escritorio y ahora están regados en el suelo.
back_translation: Suddenly, the boy throws all the papers that were on your desk and now they are scattered on the floor.

source_en: Do you think the boy knocked your papers onto the floor on purpose or by accident?
translation_es_ar: ¿Creés que el chico tiró tus papeles al suelo a propósito o por accidente?
back_translation: Do you think the boy dropped your papers on the floor on purpose or by accident?

source_en: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
translation_es_ar: Ahora elegí cuál de estas tres opciones harías vos:
back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

source_en: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.
translation_es_ar: Lee cada historia con atención. Piensa en lo que ocurrió en la historia y en lo que sabes. Elige la mejor respuesta para cada pregunta.
back_translation: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.

source_en: You've finished the instructions. Thank you!
back_translation: You've finished the instructions. Thank you!

source_en: In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
translation_es_ar: En este juego, harás algunos problemas de matemáticas. Algunos serán como los que hacés en la escuela y otros serán un poco diferentes de los que hacés en la escuela. Algunas preguntas te resultarán fáciles y otras difíciles. ¡No pasa nada! Esforzate al máximo y tomate tu tiempo. La mayoría de las preguntas tienen cuatro opciones. Elegí la que consideres correcta. ¡Empecemos!
back_translation: In this game, you'll do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school, and others will be a little different. Some questions will be easy, and others will be difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Most questions have four options. Choose the one you think is correct. Let's begin!

source_en: In this game, you will play with numbers.Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Let’s get started!
